pre_registration: written by Head DS on 2026-09-27 (the user made Head DS responsible for modelling and allowed fits without a confirmation); candidate 7 (Hawkes-like intensity) and the fresh-pair slice were added by Head DS on 2026-09-27 before the first fit; the executor's choices marked 'executor' were fixed before the first fit
question: do other model families beat the statistical model (the static list of last year) at 7 and 14 days
interpretation: registered loss of connection ('Неисправен', organizer: loss of connection with the device); not a confirmed breakdown; alarm is not a confirmed failure
policy: rolling list with release (sensor_failure_nodes.select_rolling_release): at most K open cards, window D days, a card leaves the list the day after its first event and frees its place; new cards by score for pairs without an open card; daily issue at 00:00
recall: honest (event_recall_open, user decision of 27.09.2026 in EVALUATION.md): an evaluable event counts only if a selected card of its pair is open when the event starts; the protocol recall (own window, also after release) is reported beside it and marked inflated
fold_note: as v5: embargo = horizon (fit cutoffs whose window crosses the fit/evaluate boundary are dropped); calibration (2025-01..2025-06) and holdout (2025-07..2026-06) are not read
fit_rows: as v5: candidate channel rows with a known label of the horizon, all positives plus the deterministic 10% hash sample of negatives (sensor_failure_modeling.negative_sample_mask); rows ordered by (issued_at, channel_id) so that day groups are contiguous for ranking and a fit is reproducible for a seed and thread count

features.set: F2 of v5 (prefixes hist__, cal__, cat__, ctx__; 72 columns, no value_numeric)
features.trees: numeric columns as float, cat__ columns as categories of the fit sample
features.mlp: numeric F2 columns as the within-day percentile rank (average ties) among all candidate channels of the same issue day; executor: a rank that is NaN (value missing) becomes 0 with a missing indicator for every column that has a missing value in the fit sample; cat__ columns one-hot with the categories of the fit sample; cal__ columns become constant within a day and carry no information
features.card: card score = mean of the two highest candidate channel scores of the object x sensor type (mean_top2, as v5)

executor.note: no subsampling: the seed changes only the row sample of bin construction (subsample_for_bin 200000 < fit rows)

1.weights: sensor_failure_modeling.fit_weights, as v5 (undo the 10% negative sample, then balanced classes)

executor.note: no subsampling: the three seeds are expected to give the same model; the runs check this

executor.choice: YetiRank rather than PairLogit: PairLogit generates every positive x negative pair of a day group, YetiRank samples them
executor.weights: none: a ranking loss compares rows inside one day; auto_class_weights of c3 does not apply to ranking

params.other: sklearn defaults (relu, adam, alpha 1e-4, batch 200, learning rate 1e-3, max_iter 200, validation_fraction 0.1, n_iter_no_change 10)

executor.weights: fit_weights, as v5 (the early-stopping validation accuracy is then weighted, i.e. balanced)

5.model: events of the pair object x sensor type as a Poisson process with a gamma prior per sensor type; posterior with decayed counts: a = alpha_type + sum 2^(-age/h), b = beta_type + decayed observed exposure (days); card score = P(at least one event in the next D days) = 1 - (b / (b + D))^a

executor.half_life: 90 days inherited from v5 exploration 2, where a 90-day decay was the best list variant on the same folds (a selection: optimistic for this candidate)
executor.prior: method of moments per sensor type on the fit years of the fold (pairs with >= 30 observed days): m = sum n / sum E, v = var(n/E) - m * mean(1/E), alpha = m^2 / v, beta = m / v; fewer than 3 pairs or v <= 0 -> pooled over all types; pooled v <= 0 -> alpha = 1, beta = 1/m
executor.history: events counted as the static list (the later of the pair's first member start and the moment the event is known to last >= 2 s), strictly before the cutoff; 2021 excluded (outside the project's training data) from events and exposure; a pair is observed from its first card

6.model: mean of the within-day ranks of the best ML candidate and the static list, per seed of that candidate

executor.best_ml: per horizon, among candidates 1-4, the family with the highest mean over its seeds and the horizon's K of the pooled 2023-2024 card precision under the policy; ties in the order LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost YetiRank, MLP; a selection on the same folds

7.added: by Head DS on 2026-09-27 before the first fit
7.model: intensity of the pair lambda(t) = mu_type + sum over past event starts of the pair alpha_type * exp(-(t - t_i) / tau_type); mu, alpha, tau per sensor type by maximum likelihood on the fit years of the fold only; card score = 1 - exp(-integral of lambda over [t, t + D)) with the events known before t (exact probability of at least one event in the window); no CatBoost

executor.events: as candidate 5 (counted as the static list, 2021 excluded; the likelihood covers the observed time of each pair from its first card to the fold boundary, without 2021)
executor.fallback: sensor types with fewer than 30 pair events in the fit years use the parameters fitted on all types pooled
executor.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B on log parameters, starts tau in {0.5, 5, 50, 500} days, best likelihood kept; bounds mu in [1e-7, 10] and alpha in [1e-7, 100] per day, tau in [0.05, 3650] days

7.k2: median honest lead against the list with a week bootstrap CI and the calibration (score against the share of cards with an event, fixed bins, per year): the only candidate that may know the timing (technologist criterion K2)

abort_rule: a candidate with seeds that is clearly failing on fold 2023 (seed 17 card precision below persistence at every K of the horizon) is not fitted with seeds 18 and 19 on either fold; this is reported

references.static_list: static list (правило): events of the pair in the past 365 days
references.persistence: persistence (правило): recency of the last candidate of the label on the card's channels
references.F2 CatBoost v5: saved card scores of v5 (7 days: seeds 17/18/19 of exploration 3; 14 days: seed 17 of stage 1); not refitted
references.ceiling: ORACLE ceiling (не модель): greedy oracle under the same policy

criterion.better_than_statistics: per horizon and K, all of: (1) the mean over seeds of the pooled 2023-2024 card precision is above the list; (2) the paired week-block bootstrap 95% CI of (mean over seeds of precision) - list, 2023 and 2024 together, is above 0; (3) in each fold the mean over seeds of precision minus the list is above 0; (4) the mean over seeds of the pooled honest recall is >= the list's honest recall - 0.02; otherwise 'not better than statistics'
criterion.secondary: object-block CI of the same difference; differences with persistence and F2 CatBoost v5; honest lead
criterion.winner: a candidate that meets the criterion needs a separate final check (own pre-registration); nothing here is a final result

multiplicity: 7 candidates x 5 (horizon, K) = 35 comparisons with the list for the criterion; stacking selects its ML member on the same folds; the report prints the count and the Bonferroni reading (all 400 replicates above 0)

bootstrap.blocks: cards by the ISO week of the cutoff (or object), events by the week of their start (or object); pooled 2023-2024; the same replicate weights for every score (paired)

fresh_slice.added: by Head DS on 2026-09-27 before the first fit
fresh_slice.fresh_card: the pair had no event counted as the static list in [t - L, t)
fresh_slice.fresh_event: none of the event's pairs had an event counted in [start - L, start)
fresh_slice.lookback_note: 14 days by Head DS; 7 days = D, the definition of DS-B (docs/reviews/team-brainstorm-2026-09-27/ds-b-formulation.md) for comparison
fresh_slice.mode: fresh-only list (DS-B mode b): the rolling list with release over fresh cards only; P of its cards, honest recall over fresh evaluable events; paired week/object bootstrap against the list in the same mode
fresh_slice.scores: static list, persistence, F2 CatBoost v5 and its rank mean with the list (3 seeds), every candidate 1-7 and the rank mean of each of candidates 1-5 and 7 with the list
fresh_slice.status: exploration slice, not part of the criterion
